description: The related links of the governance inventory (decision W15-8): a page statement, a shared method, a shared source, a measurement or a conceptual link, each with its stated source. A related link is listed apart and is never a dependency. The dependencies are not here since U16-P1b (BL-086): every case producer states what it reads of other cases (the committed documents and the product modules) in the depends_on list of its manifest, and the bake builds the edges from those lists (pipeline.governance.edge_table.dependency_edges). Every entry also depends on the engine node riskvalidation (implicit, W15-8). A related link is written between cases; the bake expands it to the reference entry of each case (the entry that holds the manifest's default variant, else the first fit by key).
